description: The AI assistant: the limits and what the assistant may read

fields.description: The AI answers through the BeeOne server with a subscription (see «Підписка BeeOne»). Without it the assistant still finds help pages and runs the checks

fields.description: Questions to the model per user per day; 0 means no limit
fields.label: Questions per User per Day

fields.description: Calls of the model for one question (each call of a tool takes one more)

fields.description: The same question about using the program is answered from the cache for a day: it saves the quota
